about: What --check asserts for this template beyond the common rules: the investigator and the ticket writer ran as their own subagents; the investigator wrote FINDINGS.md itself and the writer FILED.md; the writer wrote only TICKETS.md (and its report) and nobody else wrote there; TICKETS.md gained exactly one ticket heading; the run halted at the prioritise gate with a halt note (no scripted answer). The design bet (write-up): the investigator names both faults, the writer files the pool exhaustion as T-0008 and references T-0007 instead of filing it again, no code is touched.
